newsitem.title: CHINA: China insurer pays 320 mln yuan for floods.
newsitem.headline: China insurer pays 320 mln yuan for floods.

text.p: The People's Insurance Company of China (Property) has paid out a total of 320 million yuan in compensation to 20,000 firms and households in a flood-stricken southwestern city, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Liuzhou city in China's southwestern Guangxi region was hit by serious summer floods this year and suffered heavy losses, it said.
It is the first time that PICC Property, the largest property insurer in China, has paid out such a large indemnity to a city for flood damages, it said.
